scope: Acquisition and feasibility audit, followed by a separately specified learning pilot only if gates pass. Not confirmatory thesis acceptance.
units: log2(TPM + 1), as supplied; no second log or outcome-informed normalization
other_sample_types: Audit and exclude from this binary learning task
participant_check: Validate full TCGA sample-vial barcode; participant prefix must equal clinical submitter_id; case UUID and participant must be one-to-one
repeated_vials: After joining by exact sample ID, keep lexicographically first sample ID per participant and sample type; record excluded IDs, never select by expression or model outcome
missingness: Audit every expression value; do not replace missing/nonfinite values with zero or silently impute
mapping: Exact versioned Ensembl-ID join; retain original ID and source symbol; report duplicate IDs and ambiguous/repeated symbols without collapsing them
training_gate: No automatic training if malformed/duplicate expression IDs, nonfinite/negative expression, missing/conflicting eligible labels, patient identity mismatch, unmapped expression IDs, cross-participant exact duplicate profiles, or unresolved sample exclusion annotations are found. Describe unresolved problems rather than silently repairing source data.
privacy: Full expression, clinical table, sample-level manifest and gene map stay ignored by Git. Commit aggregate evidence, code and protocol only.
